name: company
description: Runs a PHP project like a small software company: a project manager plus developer, code-review and QA agents, with safety hooks.

story_budget.title: Budget per piece of work (US dollars)
story_budget.description: How much AI work one piece of the project may use, priced at Anthropic's pay-per-use rates, before the project manager stops and asks you. You get a warning at 80%. A typical piece costs about $17. Each project can change it.

project_budget.title: Budget per project (US dollars, 0 = no limit)
project_budget.description: The same, for a whole project. 0 means no limit; the project manager suggests one when a project starts.

careful_mode.title: Careful mode
careful_mode.description: Off (Quick): one developer per task and one test at the end of each piece, which costs much less. On (Careful): every task also gets a code review and a full test. Logins, payments, personal data, database changes and going live always get the careful checks.
